detail.longDescription: Larry Wall, who created Perl, a terse but expressive language more popular a few decades ago, used to say programmers should have "laziness" so they will complete tasks without extra yak-shaving, "impatience" so that they get to a solution fast, and - surprisingly - "hubris" so that they would document and write up their solutions and package them so that they are proud of them. AI has certainly made it easy to be lazy or impatient. What do you do that still makes you proud?
